name: helldivers2dock
description: Helldivers 2 stratagem macro plugins designed for Mirabox Stream Dock devices

scripts.build:runtime: npm run build:node && npm run build:helper
scripts.build: npm run prepare:variants && npm run build:runtime && npm run copy:runtime && npm run validate
scripts.build:en: node scripts/create-variants.mjs --locale en && npm run build:runtime && node scripts/validate.mjs --locale en && node scripts/test-registration.mjs --locale en
scripts.build:zh-CN: node scripts/create-variants.mjs --locale zh-CN && npm run build:runtime && npm run copy:runtime && node scripts/validate.mjs --locale zh-CN && node scripts/test-registration.mjs --locale zh-CN
scripts.validate: node scripts/validate.mjs --locale all && node scripts/test-registration.mjs --locale all
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run check:workflows
